entities.name: Alfred Biłyk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alfred Biłyk was a Polish lawyer, military officer, and politician, last Voivode of the Lwów Voivodeship. He committed suicide, when he realized that he would not be able to return to his hometown.
